name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Blacksmith, Mason, and Highrow go with Aldric, Cedric, and Matilda, in some order.
Either Southgate goes with Blacksmith or someone in the Hill Ward goes with Aldric (but not both).
At most one of Cedric, the artisan in Highrow, and the artisan in Kingsford belongs to the Ironmongers' Guild.
If Cedric belongs to the Clothiers' Guild, then Eastcheap goes with Tanner.
Blacksmith, Carpenter, and Mason go with Godfrey, Eastcheap, and Kingsford, in some order.
